intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A bell rings somewhere above the water. Nerelle ducks under to listen, then surfaces.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Underwater, that bell is lower and lasts longer. It sounds as if it means it.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “What else can you hear down there?”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Mostly boats. Their owners assume that if I am underwater, I cannot complain.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “I can. There is a barge with a squeaking rudder that I have written to three times.”

options.labelText: “What does the squeaky barge sound like from down there?”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Like a gull being disappointed very slowly.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Put your ear to the water when it passes. I will provide commentary.”

options.labelText: “Couldn’t you swim further out, away from the noise?”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “I could. Then the barge would win.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She does not move a fin’s width. Somewhere upstream, a rudder squeaks, and her eyes narrow.

options.labelText: “Maybe they’d listen if you weren’t such an odd fish.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “I am not a fish. My hearing, however, is excellent.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She sinks out of sight. She hears the next bell without you.
